english.meaning: later on, after something in the past
english.note: Only for past events, not for the future.

exampleSentences.english: Right, I’ll continue. Later on, I also looked for that sort of thing.
exampleSentences.traditional: 係喇，噉我繼續，跟住後來都有揾噉樣喇。

exampleSentences.english: Then someone helped me with those things. Later, I couldn’t walk at all, so a guy carried me off.
exampleSentences.traditional: 跟住後來呢就有人幫我，誒，整嗰啲嘢囖。跟住後來我直程行唔到嘍。有個男仔孭我走喇。
